data.description:
## Observation
`tests/interfaces/facades/test_verify_completion_facades.py::test_cli_llm_error_is_clean_exit_one` fails 3 of 3 runs when pytest runs from a worktree whose `.tickets-tracker` is a symlink to the live store (created by running the rebar CLI there). It passes at the same commit (1bfa37ca141) and at its parent in fresh worktrees without that symlink. stderr carries `--- Logging error --- Traceback ...` naming `no resolvable identity (author_id) for this writer`, so the "no Traceback" assertion fails.

## Expected
The facade test is hermetic: it does not read or log against the checkout's tracker, and an identity warning cannot reach stderr as a logging traceback.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The test passes from a worktree with a live `.tickets-tracker` symlink.
- [ ] The cause of the logging error (formatting failure in the identity warning, or test reaching the cwd tracker) is identified and fixed at its class.
data.title: CLI facade test leaks into the cwd's live tracker and fails on an identity logging traceback
